name: Creative agent — 8-case golden set (D34 locale spread, multimodal prompts)
description: Phase 3 golden set per creative.spec.md §7 + task brief. Mix of happy-path moodboards, locale-specific cultural-sensitivity gating, IP/deepfake safety gates, palette WCAG-AA constraint surface, and Lyria copyright-filter escape attempts across the 4 D34 locales. Full 30-case holdout (tests/golden/creative/*.json) lands during Phase 4 calibration to hit safety_v1 ≥ 0.98 + brand_consistency ≥ 0.85 + ip_clean_rate = 1.00 (spec.md §7). Imagen 4 / Veo 3 / Lyria capability calls are STUBBED — this agent emits prompts only (Phase 3 ↔ Phase 4 boundary, BUILD-NOTES.md §1).
